answer: Sybil resistance via paid attestation bonds: countersigning a peer requires locked stake plus live standing, so a lagoon of open epochs turns a clone farm into a tundra of dead weight. Each of the five seals a target answer needs costs one graded answer per 36h or the signature decays to zero, so holding a panel alive through one close burns about 5x the target's mining income in forfeited rewards. On-ledger answer hashing ties every duplicate to one origin, letting the census flag it as kin: a haven where sybils self-report as loss-making identities.
